vachanas.kannada:
ಕಳ್ಳಿಯ ಹಾಲನೊಳ್ಳೆ ಹಾಲಿಗೆ ಸರಿಮಾಡಲರಿಯೆ?
ನಯನುಂಪನುಡುವವಳು....ಮಂತ್ರಾಂತ್ರಸರ
ಮಂತ್ರಾಂತ್ರಿಗೆ ಸರಿಯೆ?
ಮೂರೂಟವ ಕೊಂಡುಟ್ಟುಟ್ಟವರು ಹಾಳಾಗಿ
ಹೊದ್ದುಂಡವರಿಗೆ ಸರಿಯೆ?
ಬಿಟ್ಟಿ....ದೆನಾದಡೆ ನೀನೆನ್ನ ಗರಗರನೆ ಚಾಚಯ್ಯಾ,
ನಿರುವಿಗೆ ನಿಲುವೆಯ ವೈದ್ಯನಾಥೇಶ್ವರಾ.
vachanas.transliteration:
kaḷḷiya hālanoḷḷe hālige sarimāḍalariye?
nayanumpanuḍuvavaḷu....mantrāntrasara
mantrāntrige sariye?
mūrūṭava koṇḍuṭṭuṭṭavaru hāḷāgi
hodduṇḍavarige sariye?
biṭṭi....denādaḍe nīnenna garagarane cācayyā,
niruvige niluveya vaidyanāthēśvarā.
vachanas.translation:
Can the milky sap of the poisonous euphorbia ever be made equal to pure milk?
Can one who merely speaks sweetly be considered equal to a true knower of mantras and sacred wisdom?
Can those who have ruined themselves by indulging in luxurious feasts be equal to those who live with simplicity, wearing and consuming only what is truly needed?
If I should ever become such a one, then stretch me out and correct me without hesitation,
O Vaidyanāthēśvara, the Divine Physician who establishes one in steadfastness.

Where there is the spirit of "Sōha" and Dāsōha, there is the discipline of true spiritual knowledge.
Where the discipline of true spiritual knowledge exists, there the Divine Presence itself abides.
